fields.horizon_bars: Forecast horizon in 1h bars; nullable when governed metadata has no fixed horizon
fields.ordinal: Zero-based ordinal in the 18,176-row accepted frame
fields.value: Prediction value; null outside target-eligible score rows and for governed failures.

long: One row per timestamp x selected candidate (3,570,534 rows). value is nullable and never imputed.
wide: One row per canonical BTCUSDT 1h score timestamp (ordinals 12165..18175), OHLCV plus 594 selected candidate prediction columns. Null means unavailable or governed failure.
